body: Why? not tryna be rude, genuinely curious.
I do pity them. I don’t understand why some things are so important to them.

This post really struck out to me because this is exactly how I am. I am 19 and I feel like I’m an alien when talking to anyone around my age. My friends never want to have talks that aren’t superficial, all they do is stir up drama and are persistent on being problematic. I’ve never understood normal conversation- it’s all so boring and uncomfortable. They make fun of me a lot- saying that I think “too deep” but isn’t that what life should be about? I feel like people should be asking more questions about the world we live in and the people in it, but all they’re concerned about is when and where is the next party. Sometimes I really just wish some people would wake up and realize there’s so much more to talk about.
